The '''waveskimmer''',<ref name="BGS" /> also known as an '''assault skimmer''',<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> was a small repulsorcraft used by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[aquatic assault stormtrooper]]s.<ref name="BGS" />

==Characteristics==
The waveskimmer was able to move under the [[Ocean/Legends|sea]]<ref name="BGS" /> and surf on waves.<ref name="SSR">''[[Secrets of the Sisar Run]]''</ref> It was a single person vehicle,<ref name="BGS" /> but two people could manage to ride the vehicle.<ref name="SSR" />

It carried no weapons, but the seatroopers would fire their infantry weapons while driving the waveskimmer.<ref name="BGS" /> However, a version with a mounted sonic blaster was used on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alluuvia]].<ref name="OE" />

[[Twin-pod paracapsule]]s could be used to drop two waveskimmers and two [[Aquatic assault stormtrooper|seatroopers]] from a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]].<ref name="SSR" />

==History==
The [[Imperial Aquatic Garrison]] was an undermanned garrison on the [[Waterworld/Legends|waterworld]] [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]]. It had fifteen waveskimmers assigned to the base, at least three of them were single person vehicles.<ref name="BGS" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Strike-class medium cruiser|''Strike''-class medium cruiser]] ''[[Ion Storm]]'' dropped some single person waveskimmers over Sedri, but these weren't usually carried aboard as the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] had stopped in an Imperial depot en route to requisition the appropriate equipment.<ref name="SSR" />

The [[MFB-4 Mobile Repulsor Base|Imperial Mobile Base]] in [[Elrood/Legends|Elrood]] carried ten waveskimmers equipped with sonic blasters.<ref name="OE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The vehicle appears first in pages 8,9 and 17 of ''[[Battle for the Golden Sun]]'' (1988), it appears again in pages 76-77 of ''[[Secrets of the Sisar Run]]'' (1997). The stat block is too brief and doesn't contain information about the manufacturer. It is just named waveskimmer or single person waveskimmer, which leads to some confusion.

The vehicle appears also in pages 42 and 47 of [[Operation: Elrood (book)|''Operation: Elrood'']] (1996), but the stat block states a speed of 70 km/h and adds a sonic blaster to the vehicle (other stats are the same). The waveskimmer is used on the waves in the previous appearances and is meant to be used underwater in Operation: Elrood, so 70 km/h may be either the underwater speed or the speed of the version equipped with the sonic blaster. It could also be a typo as 70 km/h is the speed of another vehicle in the same section.
